title: Pure Speedroid
summary: Speedroid and Clear Wing cards with generic staples, and no Runick or other second engine. The engine is the newest support: Colonel Clackers places Wing Synchron, which turns into Clear Wing Synchro Dragon, and Darumaknocker summons itself and searches Speedroid Spells and Traps. The Extra Deck stays almost all WIND, because Taketomborg, Darumaknocker and Colonel Clackers lock you into WIND monsters for the turn.
main: Speedroid Terrortop
Special Summons itself from the hand if you control no monsters; on summon, searches another Speedroid monster.
Speedroid Taketomborg
Special Summons itself while you control a WIND monster; Tribute it to Special Summon a Speedroid Tuner from the Deck.
Speedroid Darumaknocker

Newest support. Sends a Speedroid card from the Deck to the GY to Special Summon itself from the hand. Sent from the field to the GY: searches a Speedroid Spell/Trap, and with a Clear Wing monster out, destroys a monster.
Speedroid Colonel Clackers
Pendulum Scale: banish a Speedroid from the GY to place a Speedroid Pendulum (Wing Synchron) from the Deck. Destroyed on the field: Special Summons a Colonel Clackers as a Tuner.
Speedroid Wing Synchron
Pendulum Scale: destroys itself and a Level 2 WIND Pendulum in the other Scale, such as Colonel Clackers, to bring out Clear Wing Synchro Dragon as a Synchro Summon.
Speedroid Red-Eyed Dice
Level 1 Tuner off Taketomborg; sets another Speedroid's Level from 1 to 6 so the Synchro climbs land exactly.
Speedroid Ultra Hound
Normal Summoned: sends a Speedroid card from the Deck to the GY. From the GY: trades a Speedroid in the GY for a Speedroid Synchro of the same Level.
Speedroid Double Yoyo
Normal Summoned: revives a Level 3 or lower Speedroid.
Speedroid Marble Machine
Normal Summoned: searches a Speedroid monster. Also a Level 2 WIND Pendulum for Wing Synchron.
Speedroid Scratch
Sends a Speedroid card from the hand to the GY to search a Speedroid monster.
Speedroid Clear Wing Wonder

Destroys opposing cards, one for each different Type among your WIND Synchros (Clear Wing Dragons plus Hi-Speedroid Machines make two). From the GY: banishes and returns a WIND Synchro when the opponent Special Summons.
Speedroid Dupligate
Banishes a WIND monster from the GY to return an opposing card to the hand. Once per Duel it comes back from the GY as a Level 1 Tuner.
extra: Clear Wing Synchro Dragon
Wing Synchron's target. Negates Level 5 or higher monster effects and effects that target them.
Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon
Tuner + Synchro: negates any other monster effect and takes its ATK.
Crystal Clear Wing Synchro Dragon
Tuner Synchro (Cork Shooter) + Clear Wing: negates Spells/Traps and shrugs off monster effects.
Crystal Clear Wing Over Synchro Dragon
Glider #2 + Clear Wing: negates any card or effect, and replaces itself with a Clear Wing if the opponent removes it.
Clear Wing Fast Dragon
Level 7 WIND Synchro that zeroes and negates an Extra Deck monster on either turn.
Hi-Speedroid Glider #2
Level 5 Synchro Tuner: revives a Level 7 or lower WIND Synchro, and from the GY raises the opponent's monsters' Levels into Clear Wing's range.
Hi-Speedroid Cork Shooter
Level 3 Synchro Tuner: searches a Speedroid Spell/Trap or revives its Speedroid materials.
Hi-Speedroid Clear Wing Rider
Level 11: shuffles WIND monsters from the GY to destroy that many opposing cards, and splits into two Level 7 WIND Synchros on the opponent's turn.
Hi-Speedroid Kitedrake
Level 8 for a WIND Machine Tuner: destroys every other card on the field or negates the opponent's face-up cards.
Hi-Speedroid Puzzle
Level 4 Speedroid Synchro for Ultra Hound off Darumaknocker or Marble Machine; gets a Speedroid back at the End Phase.
Hi-Speedroid Rubber Band Shooter
WIND Link-2: an extra Normal Summon, and a Speedroid search sized to a Synchro in the Extra Deck.
